dataset.name: Pretreatment esophageal cancer biopsy cohort (2024)
dataset.description: Independent Dutch pretreatment esophageal-cancer bulk RNA-seq cohort with individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: Pretreatment diagnostic biopsies from patients with esophageal adenocarcinoma or esophageal squamous-cell carcinoma. Gastric adenocarcinomas and rows without an esophageal histology label are excluded before analysis.
dataset.publication_citation: van der Zalm et al. Communications Medicine 2024

metadata.source_data_system: NCBI GEO expression matrix and Europe PMC clinical supplement
metadata.library_method: RiboErase total RNA libraries sequenced on Illumina HiSeq 4000
metadata.curation_note: Eligibility is outcome-independent and fixed to Tumor_Type EAC or ESC. The supplied DESeq2 VST, log2-transformed, RUVg batch-corrected matrix is retained on its published scale. Versioned Ensembl identifiers are mapped using the pinned GENCODE v32 GRCh37 annotation.

expression.label: Published DESeq2 VST / RUVg scale
expression.mapping_source: GENCODE v32lift37 annotation pinned in the release
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Canonical symbols represented by multiple Ensembl identifiers are excluded rather than combined implicitly.
expression.scale_note: The publication describes DESeq2 variance stabilization, log2 transformation and RUVg batch correction. TCGA-TRACE preserves the supplied matrix without applying another transform.
